notes: Pay-when-paid 7 days, 5% retention (negotiated, citing §8811), release 'upon completion of the punch list to Contractor's satisfaction' → subjective trigger → Needs Review; joint checks allowed.

retainage.release_condition: completion of the punch list to Contractor's satisfaction and Contractor's receipt of retention from Owner

anchors.parties.contractor: Meridian Builders, Inc. ("Contractor"), a California corporation, License No. 1083421
anchors.parties.subcontractor: Pacific Electric Company ("Subcontractor"), a California corporation, License No. 1012276
anchors.parties.owner: of which Bayview Health is the owner ("Owner")
anchors.parties.project: the project known as the Bayview Clinic Tenant Improvement, 1400 Embarcadero West, Oakland, California
anchors.governing_law_state: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of California
anchors.timing.type: Receipt of payment from Owner is intended by the parties to establish the time for payment to Subcontractor and not to be a condition precedent to Contractor's obligation to pay for Work properly performed
anchors.timing.days: within seven (7) days following Contractor's receipt of payment from Owner for the Work covered by that application
anchors.timing.agreed_in_writing: within seven (7) days following Contractor's receipt of payment from Owner for the Work covered by that application
anchors.retainage.percent_bps: Contractor shall withhold five percent (5%) of each progress payment as retention
anchors.retainage.release_condition: Retention shall be released upon completion of the Punch List to Contractor's satisfaction and Contractor's receipt of the corresponding retention from Owner
anchors.retainage.release_days: and shall be paid within ten (10) days after such receipt
anchors.waivers.conditional_before_progress: a conditional waiver and release on progress payment, in the form required by California Civil Code Section 8132, for the amount requested
anchors.waivers.unconditional_after_payment: unconditional waivers and releases on progress payment, in the form required by Section 8134
anchors.waivers.lower_tier_required: from Subcontractor and from every sub-subcontractor and supplier of any tier, for all amounts previously paid
anchors.waivers.statutory_form_required: a conditional waiver and release on final payment in the form required by Section 8136 from itself and from every lower tier
anchors.offsets.joint_check: Contractor may make payment by joint check payable to Subcontractor and the unpaid party
anchors.offsets.backcharge_setoff: Contractor may do so and charge Subcontractor the cost plus fifteen percent (15%), by deduction from amounts otherwise payable
anchors.offsets.withhold_defective: Contractor may withhold from any payment an amount sufficient, in Contractor's reasonable judgment, to protect Contractor and Owner from loss on account of defective Work not corrected
anchors.stored_materials: Applications for payment may include the cost of materials and equipment delivered and suitably stored at the Project site

anomalies.description: Release is tied to completion of the punch list "to Contractor's satisfaction", a discretionary trigger with no objective date. The controller must choose an operational trigger (for example Substantial Completion as certified by the Architect).
anomalies.anchor: upon completion of the Punch List to Contractor's satisfaction
